schema: VietlishCorpusEntry (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts) - { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
author: F1 (Content Factory)
definition: Ninth-wave candidate Vietnamese-L1 interference items for human review before any promotion into VIETLISH_CORPUS. Focus areas: preposition governance, countability/articles, tense/aspect transfer, question and topic-comment word order, false friends, existential/stative calques, and service-register softening.
dedupedAgainst: F1 local check against live VIETLISH_CORPUS, pending waves 1-5 on main, and fetched in-flight wave branches 6/7/8; case-insensitive vietlish matching.
